title: OCR of one document, with positions
description: What an OCR engine read from one PDF: its lines in reading order, each with its box, its words and the checkbox in front of it, if one was detected. Written by the ocr/ package (intake-ocr run) as <id>.ocr.json, read by the extractor's text pipeline (npm run extract -- --provider local-text --ocr-dir). Boxes are on 0-1 of the page, origin top-left, like the golden's and the prediction's.

engine.description: Engine name, as given to intake-ocr --engine (tesseract, rapidocr, paddle-vl, ...).

model.description: The engine's model and version, as precisely as it reports them.

dpi.description: Resolution the pages were rendered at.

sha256.description: Of the PDF that was read; the extractor refuses a file of another PDF.

elapsed_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the whole document, rendering included. The extractor adds it to the prediction's latency.

checkboxes.description: Whether checkboxes were looked for. When false or absent, every mark is null.

width.description: Of the rendered page, in pixels.

id.description: p<page>l<n>, n counting the page's lines from 1 in reading order.

text.description: The line's words, joined by single spaces, without the checkbox.

words.description: Empty when the engine reports lines only.

mark.description: The checkbox in front of the line: ticked, empty, or none detected (also when it was too doubtful to call).
